Edited on 6 October: So I managed to get the game to work by moving it to my C:, then go through the "steamapps" folder to \EA SPORTS WRC\WRC\Binaries\Win64

Then you have to manually launch as admin the EAanticheatgameservicelauncher EXE file. The splash screen should come up, then close. Then you should hopefully be able to run the game normally through Steam.

Using the above I've been able to get the game working consistently now. Played a ton more hours. Game is fantastic and the new 2024 cars and the two new locations are great too.

Calling this game Dirt Rally 3.0 would be accurate, and it's not a bad thing. It's everything good about the Dirt Rally franchise, but improved on even more so. The offroad physics are still challenging and fun, while the tarmac physics have been vastly improved from the previous games. Both the car list and the stage list is big and diverse from one to another, but with the seasons option it changes them even more so to the point you can race the same car at the same stage, but still get a different experience. The game is still not perfect: the games performance is still poor even on high end PC, the online has many moods and sometimes works perfectly, but sometimes it decides to screw up with the rally standing or just kick everyone from the session mid rally and some car classes feel incredible and diverse, while others feel a bit abandoned with pretty much 1 or 2 choices (unless you want to be finishing last). Overall the game deserves a solid 8,5/10 with a chance to become a 9,5/10 when the performance issues get fixed along with future content updates. Let's hope the game achieves big enough success to make all rally fans happy for the coming years.
